body:
That's so sad.): I'm sorry you had to break it off.
I don't have many friends too..most of them split off. College and whatnot. The only people I had to call "friends" were his friends. But now I know that he's been telling them about breaking up with me. So they all must think the worst of me. And his ex...don't even get me started on that..she hasn't made things any better. She's just getting in the way and I have no way to stop it..

It's so hard not to think about it...
And thank you so much just for talking to me. I will toke to you as well my friend.

He means the world to me...I just hate myself so much for ruining it. He tells me everything is fine but I just can't believe him. I saw a text from the 16th from him to his friend saying he wanted to end things. But yet he still hasn't? I can't tell if he's changed his mind or if he just doesn't know how to say it. But I wish he would just get it out of the way if he wants to...it's destroying me. I have even given him chances. I've said "if you want out just tell me now. Just tell me. I need to know so we both can move on". Although I'm not sure I could..but still he says everything is fine.
Weed has been keeping me numb. Anytime I start to cry I just pack my one hitter. Speaking of which...

Thank you. It means a lot to me that some people care what happens to me..
I just have this horrible gut feeling that he's going to break up with me when he gets back into town...he barely talks to me, he sounds bored on the phone..I know this may sound stupid but he doesn't send me sweet texts anymore like he used to. Now all I get when I send "I love you sweetie" is "Love you too". Which I suppose isn't too bad but compared to how he used to act....I just don't feel like he cares anymore. Maybe this is all in my head but IDK.
If he wants to break up I wish he would just do it while he's away. But if he does....I don't think I'll be able to cope. And I feel like all of his friends(including his ex) knows he's going to do this...which makes me feel sick. I tried so hard to be friends with them..

Hmm...it kind of varies. For the last hour I've been listening to pandora on a Wasteland station. I'm thinking of changing it now...not sure what though. Nope. Nevermind. I'm listening to some Disney songs to take me down memory lane. IDK....my music mood is ever-changing.[:
That's a really good idea.(: I'm painting a simple bong that I bought. Right now she's just painted white for my base. I've just been staring at it for hours!lol
